collection.description: A diver finds a reef covered in tiny organisms whose patterns look like writing.

premise.name: The premise
premise.text: A diver discovers a reef covered in tiny organisms whose patterns resemble writing.

a.name: Answer A
a.text: The symbols prove hard to reproduce accurately.

b.name: Answer B
b.text: The sample is examined without breaking the living colony.

d.name: Answer D
d.text: Magic, nature, spirit and science each offer a reading; none becomes official truth.

c__fx.name: Answer C
c__fx.text: The exciting claim spreads before evidence exists; a later correction causes embarrassment.
